name: Can I install a new lever faucet myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I install a new lever faucet myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it is possible for experienced DIY enthusiasts to install a new lever faucet, hiring a professional is often recommended, especially if you lack plumbing experience. Incorrect installation can lead to leaks, water damage, or issues with water pressure. Professionals have the right tools, experience, and knowledge to ensure the faucet is installed correctly, adheres to local codes, and functions optimally, providing peace of mind and preventing costly future repairs.
